role: USABLE dataset (Phase 3.2-J.3, promoted from PREPARED_CANDIDATE per J.1/J.2's zh-only decision). Provides native, memory-ID-typed gold evidence and a genuinely new memory-classification workload not present in any active dataset. NOT registered under phase3/evaluation/datasets/profile.schema.json (that schema is frozen to the 4 canonical-active datasets' dataset_id enum) -- this is a shape-compatible sibling profile, consumed identically by integration/validation.py and integration/pipeline.py, which read plain dict keys and do not enforce the frozen schema's enum.

registry_reference.record_count_reference: registry_entry.json: record_count=8593, memory_count=7521 (full scan, zh release only, J.1).

inspection_method.description: Full-scan inspection (not sample-based) performed in Phase 3.2-J.1/J.2: all 8,593 zh task records and 7,521 memory units scanned for null answers, Reference-Memory-ID validity, and Memory-Anchors span resolution.

stable_id.reason: Every memory unit carries a native_memory_unit_id (or the literal string 'profile' for profile-section units), encoded NATIVE_MEMORY_ID (character-scope-resolved) via identity.encode_perltqa_memory_identity -- verified collision-free across all 7,521 units.

unique_id.reason: Full-scan collision check (not a sample): 7,521/7,521 character-scoped composite identities are unique.

content_available.reason: Every memory record carries a non-empty agent_visible_context (structured profile fields, or a social_relationship/events/dialogues unit's own fields).

timestamped.reason: Only events-kind memory units carry Creation Time/Last Accessed Time free-text fields; not uniformly machine-parseable, and social_relationship/profile/dialogues units carry none.

session_linked.reason: dialogues unit IDs are suffixed event IDs (e.g. '4_0_0#0' groups under event '4_0_0') -- a real but coarse session-like grouping; no separate explicit session_id field.

typed_foundation_or_derived.reason: No explicit foundation-vs-derived type tag exists; every PerLTQA memory unit is a foundation memory by construction (no parent-edge structure exists at all).

explicit_parent_ids_present.reason: Full-scan (all languages, J.1): zero parent_ids/equivalent_to fields anywhere in the source.
explicit_parent_ids_present.grounding: phase3/datasets/candidates/perltqa/normalized/memory_records.jsonl (parent_ids field, literal NOT_PROVIDED_BY_SOURCE on every record)

explicit_task_records.reason: normalized/task_records.jsonl exists with 8,593 zh records, each distinct from any memory_id.

separate_from_memory.reason: task_records.jsonl is a physically separate file with a disjoint schema from memory_records.jsonl.

query_field.reason: Every task record carries a non-empty agent_visible.question string (Chinese, source-native, never translated).

gold_answer_field.reason: Full scan: 0/8,593 null or empty answers in the zh release.

task_id_field.reason: Every task record carries a source_record_id distinct in shape from any memory identity.

session_or_conversation_id.reason: character field links a task to its owning character's memory units; not a session/conversation id in the LoCoMo sense.

evidence_availability.reason: Non-profile sections (social_relationship/events/dialogues, 8,236/8,593 = 95.8% of all task records) carry native, memory-ID-resolvable evidence (100% valid, full scan). Profile-section records (357/8,593, 4.2%) carry a classification LABEL, not an evidence-ID pointer, in the same source field -- so evidence_availability is PARTIAL at the dataset level, not AVAILABLE, even though the non-profile majority is fully resolvable.

provenance_availability.reason: Every normalized record carries source_revision (github_repo_commit) pointing back to the pinned source commit.

lineage_availability.reason: No parent_ids edges exist anywhere (full scan) -- no lineage graph to walk.

equivalence_availability.reason: No equivalent_to edges exist anywhere (full scan, all languages).
equivalence_availability.grounding: phase3/datasets/candidates/perltqa/normalized/memory_records.jsonl (equivalent_to field, literal NOT_PROVIDED_BY_SOURCE on every record)

temporal_information.reason: Only events-kind memory units carry free-text Creation Time/Last Accessed Time fields; not machine-parseable dates in all cases, and most memory kinds carry no temporal field at all -- distinct from LoCoMo/LongMemEval's TIMESTAMPED_ABSOLUTE and from MSC/Conversation Chronicles's ORDERED_SEQUENCE_ONLY.

RECALL_AT_K.reason: Native Reference Memory IDs, character-scope-resolved via encode_perltqa_memory_identity -- SUPPORTED for the 95.8% non-profile majority; profile-section records have no evidence-ID gold set for this metric.

STRICT_TSR.reason: gold_evidence_ids are real, character-scope-resolved memory IDs for non-profile records; strict_tsr()'s canonical set-intersection definition applies unmodified.

SELECTION_COUNT.reason: Generic over any selected-id sequence; no dataset-specific precondition.

SELECTION_CAPACITY_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: Requires a gold_id, available for non-profile records.

REDUNDANCY.reason: Identity-duplicate-only, needs only a selected-id sequence.

EQUIVALENCE_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: No equivalent_to edges exist (full scan, 0 matches).

PROVENANCE_VALIDATION.reason: Every record has a source_revision pointer; provenance validation does not require parent_ids.

LINEAGE_DIAGNOSTICS.reason: No parent_ids edges exist (full scan, 0 matches).

AGENT_ANSWER_CORRECTNESS.reason: 0/8,593 null/empty answers (full scan); evaluate_answer_correctness's .strip()-only exact match is language-agnostic (verified by direct code inspection, J.1).

MEMORY_CONTRIBUTION.reason: Requires gold answers (present, 100%) and evidence (present for non-profile majority).

RETRIEVAL_UTILIZATION.reason: Needs only selected/used_memory_ids from an AgentExecutionResult; no dataset-specific gold dependency.

FAILURE_STAGE_CLASSIFICATION.reason: Requires gold_evidence_ids (present for non-profile majority) and an expected_answer (present, 100%).

NO_MEMORY.reason: build_agent_visible_context needs only task_id/question, both present.

GOLD_EVIDENCE.reason: Gold evidence content assemblable from encoded evidence IDs -> memory lookup, for the 95.8% non-profile majority.

RETRIEVED_MEMORY.reason: Requires a real candidate-discovery/reranking/selection pipeline, not implemented anywhere in Phase 3.2 -- see adapter_requirements.

DERIVED_MEMORY_AVAILABLE.reason: No derived memories exist (no parent_ids anywhere).

CONFLICTING_MEMORY_AVAILABLE.reason: No conflicts_with edges exist anywhere in the source.

adapter_requirements: A candidate-discovery + reranking + selection pipeline over normalized/memory_records.jsonl -- not implemented anywhere yet; this profile describes the requirement, it does not build it.

An explicit policy decision on whether profile-section records (357/8,593, no evidence-ID basis) should be scored as answer-correctness-only cases or excluded from evidence-based metrics entirely -- this profile does not decide the policy, it only reports the PARTIAL status.
limitations: This profile covers the zh release ONLY -- en/en_v2 are explicitly NOT covered here (per J.1's finding that both English releases have 81.3% non-profile null answers) and must never be loaded through this profile.

evidence_availability/most metric_support entries are PARTIAL/SUPPORTED_WITH_ADAPTER, not AVAILABLE/SUPPORTED outright, because the 357 profile-section records genuinely have no evidence-ID gold basis -- this is a real, disclosed dataset-shape distinction, not a data-quality gap.

Not registered under the frozen phase3/evaluation/datasets/profile.schema.json (dataset_id enum locked to the 4 canonical-active datasets) -- this profile is a shape-compatible sibling, consumed by the same integration.validation/pipeline functions, which read plain dict keys without enforcing that schema.

evidence_notes.claim: Native Reference Memory ID-lists resolve against the correct character's memory dict for 100% of non-profile records (full scan).
0/8,593 null or empty answers (full scan, zh).
Character-scoped composite identity is collision-free across all 7,521 memory units (full scan).
